packages.name: Swiss Alps & Glacier Wonders Odyssey
packages.description: Experience the majestic beauty of the Swiss Alps, from Zurich to the snow-capped peaks of Jungfraujoch and the scenic Glacier Express through Zermatt.
highlights: Scenic journey on the Glacier Express panorama train
Summit excursion to Jungfraujoch — Top of Europe (3,454m)
Walking tour of historic Lucerne and Chapel Bridge
Lake Geneva sunset catamaran cruise with Swiss fondue dinner
inclusions: Daily Swiss buffet breakfasts & 4 curated regional dinners
Swiss Travel Pass (1st Class) with panoramic Glacier Express reservation
All mountain railway & cable car passes (Jungfraujoch, Titlis, Matterhorn Glacier Paradise)
exclusions: Personal expenses & optional adventure activities (paragliding, helicopter tour)

itinerary.desc: Arrive at Zurich Airport (ZRH). Meet your tour manager and take a scenic 1st class train to Lucerne. Enjoy an evening welcome orientation and a stroll along the historic Chapel Bridge.
itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich & Transfer to Lucerne

itinerary.desc: Ascend Mount Titlis aboard the world's first revolving cable car, the Titlis Rotair. Walk across the Titlis Cliff Walk suspension bridge and explore the illuminated Glacier Cave.
itinerary.title: Mount Titlis Glacier & Rotair Cable Car

itinerary.desc: Travel through the Bernese Oberland to Lauterbrunnen. Board the cogwheel railway to Jungfraujoch (3,454m). Visit the Sphinx Observatory and Ice Palace.
itinerary.title: Interlaken & Journey to Jungfraujoch — Top of Europe

itinerary.desc: Board the world-famous Glacier Express for a breathtaking 4.5-hour journey over 291 bridges and through 91 tunnels. Arrive in the car-free mountain haven of Zermatt.
itinerary.title: Glacier Express Panorama Train to Zermatt

itinerary.desc: Take Europe's highest 3S cableway to Matterhorn Glacier Paradise (3,883m) for 360-degree panoramic views of 38 alpine peaks across Switzerland, Italy, and France.
itinerary.title: Matterhorn Glacier Paradise & Alpine Hike

itinerary.desc: Travel west to Montreux along the Swiss Riviera. Visit the medieval Château de Chillon on Lake Geneva and savor an authentic Swiss cheese fondue dinner.
itinerary.title: Lake Geneva, Montreux & Chillon Castle

itinerary.desc: Morning leisure stroll along Lake Geneva's promenade. Guided group transfer to Geneva International Airport (GVA) for your return flight home.
itinerary.title: Geneva Departure & Homeward Bound

packages.name: Explore Vietnam
packages.description:
Vietnam is a Southeast Asian country known for its rich history, diverse culture, and stunning landscapes. It has a long
coastline, vibrant cities like Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, and is famous for its cuisine and historical sites. Today, it is a
popular tourist destination, offering a mix of natural beauty, ancient heritage, and modern growth.
highlights: Main and Internal Flights are Included (as per Base Fare). – from Mumbai
4* Accommodation in above mentioned hotels on Double / Twin sharing basis.
All transfers and sightseeing tours on Private basis (45-seater bus) unless specified as SIC
Accommodation on twin/triple-share basis with daily breakfast (Check-in: 15:00 | Check-out: 12:00)
English Speaking Guide as per itinerary
All entrance fees as per itinerary
Meals as mentioned in programme: B = Breakfast, L = Lunch, D = Dinner
2 bottles of 500ml drinking water per person per day

itinerary.desc:
Our English-speaking guide will meet and welcome you at the international airport and transfer you to the city
centre.

Enjoy breakfast at an Indian Restaurant. Then explore the city's historic landmarks with your guide:
• Presidential Palace – Headquarters of the Saigon Government during the Vietnam-American War
• Notre Dame Cathedral (from outside only) – A magnificent red brick building with twin spires inspired by the
original in Paris
• Central Post Office – Designed by French architect Gustave Eiffel

After the tour, transfer to hotel for check-in.
Check-in Time: 15:00 hrs. Early check-in subject to availability with surcharge.

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner at Indian Restaurant (restaurant chosen by us)
Guide: English Speaking Guide
Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.
itinerary.title: ARRIVAL HO CHI MINH CITY | HALF DAY CITY TOUR

itinerary.desc:
Take the morning flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, transfer to hotel for check-in. Begin city tour visiting the 4 famous bridges:

• Han River Bridge – The first swing bridge built by Vietnamese architects (1997), a symbol of the city's
emergence
• Tran Thi Ly Bridge – The bridge's elegant pylon and deck change colours at night creating an iconic
landmark
• Dragon Bridge – Every weekend at 9:00 PM the dragon breathes fire and water (visit by own arrangement)
• Love Lock Bridge – Enchanting at night with thousands of heart-shaped red lanterns
Continue to Son Tra Peninsula (Monkey Mountain) to visit the Linh Ung Bai But Pagoda, home to the tallest Lady
Buddha statue in Vietnam, and the beautiful My Khe Beach.

Meals: Breakfast at hotel, Lunch & Dinner at Indian Restaurant
Guide: English Speaking Guide
Overnight stay in Da Nang.
itinerary.title: FLIGHT TO DA NANG | HALF DAY CITY TOUR

itinerary.title: Mt. Titlis Rotating Cable Car & Cliff Walk

itinerary.desc: Full-day excursion to Jungfraujoch (3,454m) with cogwheel train ride and panoramic lunch at the Top of Europe summit.
itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch Summit Excursion

itinerary.desc: Exclusive panoramic coach reserved on the Glacier Express to Zermatt under the Matterhorn.
itinerary.title: Glacier Express Panorama Ride to Zermatt

itinerary.desc: Morning cable car ride to 3,883m Matterhorn Glacier Paradise. Afternoon chocolate & cheese tasting in Zermatt village.
itinerary.title: Matterhorn Glacier Paradise Exploration

itinerary.desc: Scenic rail transfer to Lake Geneva. Private guided tour of Chillon Castle followed by lakeside fondue evening.
itinerary.title: Montreux, Chillon Castle & Fondue Dinner

itinerary.desc: Group transfer to Geneva Airport (GVA) for flights departing after 2:00 PM.
